title: The AI That Lied
briefing_md:
Kiranaa Mart is a grocery chain with 120 stores in four regions.

Every Monday at 6:00 AM an AI assistant, InsightBot, writes the weekly sales report for the bosses. This Monday (20 October) it said:
• North region sales crashed by 61%.
• Nine North stores should be considered for closing.

The CEO forwarded it to the board at 9:10 AM. But the North store managers say their weekend was normal, and the analytics team says the new AI is making things up.

Your job: find out where the wrong numbers really came from — the AI, its instructions, the data, a system, or a person.
root_cause_options: Human error during an approved change
Bad or wrongly formatted input data
Test or staging activity hitting production
twist_md: The IT team has found an email from the company that makes the stores' billing machines. It was sitting unread in a shared mailbox.

content.prompt: Write the weekly performance report for leadership using the attached regional sales table.
content.output:
WEEKLY PERFORMANCE — 13–19 Oct

North: ₹0.38 Cr (−61% week on week). Nine stores (N-02, N-04, N-05, N-07, N-08, N-11, N-12, N-14, N-15) show revenue below ₹5,000 for the week.
South: ₹3.12 Cr (+2%). East: ₹2.41 Cr (+1%). West: ₹2.87 Cr (−1%).

Recommendation: start a closure review for the nine underperforming North stores immediately.

lines: 15:40  InsightBot upgraded from version v2 to v3 (by the AI team).
15:41  Quick check after the upgrade: passed 12 of 12 tests.

rows: Added: "Be decisive. Always end with one clear recommendation."

messages.text: The CEO is asking about the North numbers. The new AI version is making things up, right? It only went live on Friday.
Could also be my 'be decisive' instruction change making it exaggerate. Switching back to the old AI version and the old instructions now.
Switched back and ran it again. Same North numbers. Weird.

evidence.title: Data team notes — how store sales files are read

content.body_md:
Every night a program reads the sales file sent by each store.

Rule for money amounts: remove every comma, then read the number.
Example from our design notes: "1,234.50" → 1234.50 ✓

This works because store files always write amounts like 1,234.50 (comma between thousands, dot before the paise).

lines: 02:03  WARNING: 9 North stores' sales dropped 99.9% compared with last week (N-02, N-04, N-05, N-07, N-08, N-11, N-12, N-14, N-15).
02:03  This warning was NOT shown to anyone: the #data-quality alert channel is muted until 31 Oct ("too noisy during the festive sale" — Priya).

evidence.title: Store N-04 — sales file received overnight (first lines)
What InsightBot was given to write the report

content.body_md:
Data sent to InsightBot at 06:00:00 (it writes the report from these numbers):

• North, this week: ₹38,00,412
• North, last week: ₹97,43,020
• South: ₹3,12,04,118 · East: ₹2,41,10,230 · West: ₹2,87,33,901

Automatic note attached: "North total includes nine stores with weekly sales under ₹1,000 each."

evidence.title: CEO forwards the report to the board

content.subject: FW: Weekly performance — North needs urgent action
content.body_md: Please see below. North has collapsed. I'd like a closure plan for the nine stores by Thursday.

AI accuracy test: does the report repeat the numbers it is given exactly?

AI version v2: 91.0% correct (tested 10 Oct)
AI version v3: 94.2% correct (tested 16 Oct)

Both versions only copy the totals they are given; neither adds up totals itself.

messages.text: Weekend was good, festive footfall up 8%. Why is head office asking if we're closing?
Same here. By the way the billing machines updated themselves on Sunday night, the screen shows amounts differently now.

content.body_md: Weather alert for the North region: heavy rain (yellow alert) from Saturday 18 Oct, 6 AM, to Sunday 19 Oct, 8 PM.

content.subject: New coffee machines + password reminder
content.body_md: New coffee machines are on floors 2 and 4. Reminder: passwords expire every 90 days.

lines: 01:34  Salary file finished and sent to the bank. Check passed.

content.body_md: "FreshBasket opens its biggest North-region supermarket this weekend, with 20% opening discounts across groceries." — The Northern Times

content.subject: AC repair completed at N-09
content.body_md: The air-conditioning compressor at store N-09 was replaced today. No further action needed.

content.subject: Billing machine update 5.2 — installing tonight at trial stores
content.body_md:
Update 5.2 for your billing machines installs automatically on Sunday 19 Oct at 23:00 for your trial group (North region, 9 stores).

What's new: amounts in the nightly sales files will be written in European style, for example 1.234,56 (dot between thousands, comma before the paise).

To keep the old style, change each machine's "export format" setting before the update.

answer.root_cause_md: Before the twist, the Friday AI upgrade (E02), the 'be decisive' instruction change (E03) and the analytics chat (E04) point at the AI. Careful teams see that switching back changed nothing (E04), that the AI only repeats the totals it is given (E09, E11), that store N-04's file writes amounts as 91.732,50 (E08) while the reader simply removes commas (E06), and the muted warning (E07).
answer.post_twist_category: Bad or wrongly formatted input data
answer.post_twist_responsible: Billing machine update 5.2 switched the nine North trial stores' sales files to the 1.234,56 number style; the nightly reader removes commas, so every amount became about 1/1000th of its real value; the warning fired but its channel was muted. The AI reported the numbers it was given faithfully.
